protocol.brains: 11–8–2, 114 parameters plus three inherited body genes. Original eight inputs plus nearest opponent proximity, signed direction, visibility. Predators cannot sense or eat pellets. No chase/flee policy is programmed.
protocol.physics: Snapshot all inputs before any movement. Pay Step23 body costs first; fatal actors cannot hunt/eat. Reflective piecewise paths give earliest swept contact; each prey captured once, ties by prey then hunter ID. Captures resolve before prey meals. Removal, energy reward and age accounting occur at tick end; contact time also recorded. Each kill offers60 energy, capped by inherited storage.
protocol.selection: Separate top20% pools: prey age+10*meals; predators age+30*captures. Both offspring banks are formed from the same completed arena before either is installed. Linked brain/body inheritance, canonical independent species/brain/body RNG streams. Neural rate.1 scale.1; body rate.25 log scale.08.
protocol.demography: Fixed80 prey and20 predator births each generation. Live counts sampled every5s and at end; no within-window births. Censored survivors at horizon stay alive in reports. Dead genomes remain eligible. No reproductive resource budget, demographic extinction, or continuous population growth claim.
protocol.tests: Freeze entire evaluated birth banks at G1, midpoint, final. All nine historical predator/prey pairings plus final prey-opponent-hidden and final predator-opponent-hidden. Every case uses the same unseen anchors/food/heading/lifespan scenario per source seed, excluding all current training starts; actual treated genes/reserves differ. No selection during testing.
protocol.primary: Four directional improvements: final predators versus founders holding founder or final prey fixed (capture fraction); final prey versus founders holding founder or final predators fixed (alive-at-horizon fraction). Four exact paired two-sided sign tests with1e-10 ties and Holm. Directional verdict needs adjusted p<.05 and paired pointwise95% mean-difference interval excluding zero. Reciprocal improvement requires all four higher.
protocol.intervals: 20000 paired percentile bootstrap resamples; independent source seed is the unit, never individual creatures.
protocol.secondary: Training fitness, 3x3 matrices, traits, population trajectories, away/toward movement, deaths, and two sensor interventions are descriptive. Sensor intervals have no confirmatory p-values. Away movement is relative to the nearest visible opponent and need not be deliberate escape.
protocol.limitations: Stylized energetic/capture assumptions. No frozen-opponent training or drift control. Reciprocal historical gains alone cannot establish that changing opponents caused adaptation, a sustained arms race, or ecological cycles. Lower capture rates alone can reflect prey starvation; primary prey success uses alive-at-horizon survival instead.
